questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Simplify: (2/3) - (1/6)
questions.explanation: Using a common denominator of 6: (2/3 = 4/6) - (1/6) = 3/6 = 1/2.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Find x if 6x + 3 = 3x + 21
questions.explanation: 6x + 3 = 3x + 21, so 3x = 18, giving x = 6.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: What is 15% of 480?

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: The average of 8 numbers is 12. What is their sum?
questions.explanation: Sum = average x count = 12 x 8 = 96.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Solve: x^2 - 25 = 0
questions.explanation: x^2 = 25, so x = sqrt(25) = +-5, giving x = 5 or x = -5.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: If the ratio of black to white marbles is 3:7 and there are 9 black marbles, how many white marbles are there?
questions.explanation: 3 parts = 9, so 1 part = 3. White marbles = 7 parts = 7 x 3 = 21.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: What is the perimeter of a rectangle with length 12cm and width 5cm?
questions.explanation: Perimeter of a rectangle = 2(length + width) = 2(12+5) = 2 x 17 = 34cm.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: What is the area of a circle with radius 7cm? (Use pi = 22/7)

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Simplify: 2^3 x 2^4
questions.explanation: When multiplying powers with the same base, add the exponents: 2^3 x 2^4 = 2^7 = 128.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: What is the value of the square root of 196?
questions.explanation: The square root of 196 is 14, since 14 x 14 = 196.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: A motorist travels 120km in 4 hours. What is their average speed?
questions.explanation: Average speed = distance/time = 120/4 = 30 km/h.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Solve for x: (x/5) - 2 = 3

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: What is the sum of the interior angles of a heptagon (7 sides)?
questions.explanation: The sum of interior angles of a polygon = (n-2) x 180, so for a heptagon (n=7): (7-2) x 180 = 900 degrees.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: What is the sum of the interior angles of an octagon (8 sides)?
questions.explanation: Using (n-2) x 180 for an octagon (n=8): (8-2) x 180 = 1080 degrees.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Factorise: x^2 - 9x + 20
questions.explanation: We need two numbers that multiply to 20 and add to -9: -4 and -5. So x^2-9x+20 = (x-4)(x-5).

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: What is 0.75 expressed as a fraction in its lowest terms?
questions.explanation: 0.75 = 75/100, which simplifies to 3/4 when divided by 25.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: If a = 4 and b = -2, find the value of a^2 - b^2

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: What is the median of the data set: 2, 7, 9, 13, 18?
questions.explanation: With 5 values arranged in order (2,7,9,13,18), the median is the middle value: 9.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: What is the mode of the data set: 4, 6, 6, 7, 9, 6, 10?
questions.explanation: The mode is the most frequently occurring value; 6 appears three times, more than any other value.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Convert 3/8 to a percentage.
questions.explanation: 3/8 = 0.375, which as a percentage is 37.5%.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: What is the LCM (Lowest Common Multiple) of 9 and 12?
questions.explanation: Multiples of 9: 9,18,27,36...; multiples of 12: 12,24,36...; the smallest common multiple is 36.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: What is the HCF (Highest Common Factor) of 24 and 36?
questions.explanation: The factors of 24 are 1,2,3,4,6,8,12,24; factors of 36 are 1,2,3,4,6,9,12,18,36; the highest common factor is 12.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: If 2x + 3y = 18 and x = 3, find the value of y.
questions.explanation: Substituting x=3: 2(3) + 3y = 18, so 6 + 3y = 18, giving 3y = 12, so y = 4.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: A trader sells an item for N9,000 after a 25% discount on the original price. What was the original price?
questions.explanation: If N9,000 represents 75% of the original price, then original price = 9,000/0.75 = N12,000.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: What is the next number in the sequence: 4, 12, 36, 108, ___?
questions.explanation: Each term is multiplied by 3 to get the next term: 108 x 3 = 324.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Simplify: (5a^3b) x (3ab^2)
questions.explanation: Multiplying coefficients: 5x3=15. Multiplying a terms: a^3 x a = a^4. Multiplying b terms: b x b^2 = b^3. Result: 15a^4b^3.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: What is the value of x in the equation: 3(x - 2) = 2(x + 4)

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: A rectangular plot has an area of 200 square metres and a width of 8 metres. What is its length?
questions.explanation: Length = Area/Width = 200/8 = 25 metres.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: What is the probability of picking a blue ball from a bag containing 5 blue and 7 red balls?
questions.explanation: Total balls = 5 + 7 = 12. Probability of blue = 5/12.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Express 3.6 x 10^3 as an ordinary number.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: What is the value of the square root of 144 plus the square root of 81?
questions.explanation: Square root of 144 is 12 and square root of 81 is 9, so 12 + 9 = 21.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Simplify: 5^3 ÷ 5

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Evaluate: 2^-3
questions.explanation: A negative exponent gives a reciprocal: 2^-3 = 1/2^3 = 1/8.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Simplify: x^5 ÷ x^2
questions.explanation: When dividing powers with the same base, subtract the exponents: x^5 ÷ x^2 = x^(5-2) = x^3.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Evaluate: 9^(1/2)
questions.explanation: A power of 1/2 represents a square root: 9^(1/2) = sqrt(9) = 3.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Evaluate: 27^(1/3)
questions.explanation: A power of 1/3 represents a cube root: 27^(1/3) = cube root of 27 = 3, since 3x3x3 = 27.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Simplify: (2^3)^2
questions.explanation: When raising a power to a power, multiply the exponents: (2^3)^2 = 2^6 = 64.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: If log base 10 of 100 = x, find x.
questions.explanation: Since 10^2 = 100, log base 10 of 100 = 2.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Evaluate: log base 2 of 8
questions.explanation: Since 2^3 = 8, log base 2 of 8 = 3.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Convert 1011 (base 2) to base 10.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Convert 25 (base 10) to base 2.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Convert 23 (base 5) to base 10.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Simplify: 3^2 x 3^-1
questions.explanation: When multiplying powers with the same base, add the exponents: 3^2 x 3^-1 = 3^(2-1) = 3^1 = 3.

questions.text: Evaluate: log10 1000 - log10 10

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Expand: (x + 3)(x - 3)
questions.explanation: This is a difference of two squares: (x+3)(x-3) = x^2 - 9.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Factorise: x^2 - 16
questions.explanation: x^2 - 16 is a difference of two squares, since 16 = 4^2, giving (x-4)(x+4).

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Factorise: 2x^2 + 5x - 3
questions.explanation: Splitting the middle term: 2x^2 + 6x - x - 3 = 2x(x+3) - 1(x+3) = (2x-1)(x+3).

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Solve: x^2 - 7x + 12 = 0
questions.explanation: We need two numbers that multiply to 12 and add to -7: -3 and -4. So (x-3)(x-4) = 0, giving x = 3 or x = 4.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Simplify: (3x^2y)(4xy^3)
questions.explanation: Multiplying coefficients: 3x4=12. Multiplying x terms: x^2 x x = x^3. Multiplying y terms: y x y^3 = y^4. Result: 12x^3y^4.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: If x + y = 10 and x - y = 4, find the value of x.
questions.explanation: Adding the two equations: 2x = 14, so x = 7.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Make r the subject of the formula A = pi r^2
questions.explanation: Dividing both sides by pi gives r^2 = A/pi, then taking the square root gives r = sqrt(A/pi).

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Simplify: (x^2 - 4)/(x - 2), for x not equal to 2
questions.explanation: x^2 - 4 factorises to (x-2)(x+2), so dividing by (x-2) leaves x + 2.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Solve the inequality: 3x - 5 > 10
questions.explanation: 3x - 5 > 10, so 3x > 15, giving x > 5.

questions.subject: Mathematics

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Simplify: (a+b)^2 - (a-b)^2
questions.explanation: (a+b)^2 = a^2+2ab+b^2 and (a-b)^2 = a^2-2ab+b^2; subtracting gives 4ab.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Solve for x: x/3 + x/4 = 7
questions.explanation: Using a common denominator of 12: 4x/12 + 3x/12 = 7, so 7x = 84, giving x = 12.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Factorise completely: 6x^2 - 24
questions.explanation: Taking out the common factor 6 first gives 6(x^2-4), which factorises further to 6(x-2)(x+2).

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: If f(x) = 2x^2 - 3x + 1, find f(2).

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.explanation: 4x - 8 - 3x + 3 = 0, so x - 5 = 0, giving x = 5.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Simplify: 2(x - 3) + 3(2x + 1)
questions.explanation: 2(x-3) = 2x - 6, and 3(2x+1) = 6x + 3; adding gives 8x - 3.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Solve for x: (2x+1)/3 = 5
questions.explanation: Multiplying both sides by 3: 2x + 1 = 15, so 2x = 14, giving x = 7.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: If 3x - 2y = 12 and y = 3, find the value of x.
questions.explanation: Substituting y=3: 3x - 6 = 12, so 3x = 18, giving x = 6.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Find the 10th term of the arithmetic progression: 3, 7, 11, 15, ...
questions.explanation: First term a=3, common difference d=4. The nth term is a+(n-1)d, so the 10th term is 3 + 9(4) = 3 + 36 = 39.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Find the sum of the first 10 terms of the arithmetic progression: 2, 5, 8, ...

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Find the common ratio of the geometric progression: 5, 15, 45, 135, ...
questions.explanation: Each term is obtained by multiplying the previous term by 3, since 15/5 = 45/15 = 135/45 = 3.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Find the 6th term of the geometric progression: 2, 6, 18, ...
questions.explanation: a=2, r=3. The 6th term is a x r^5 = 2 x 3^5 = 2 x 243 = 486.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Find the sum to infinity of the geometric progression: 8, 4, 2, 1, ...

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Find the nth term of the arithmetic progression with first term 5 and common difference 3.
questions.explanation: The nth term is a+(n-1)d = 5+(n-1)3 = 5+3n-3 = 3n+2.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: The first term of an arithmetic progression is 4 and the 5th term is 20. Find the common difference.
questions.explanation: T5 = a+4d, so 4+4d=20, giving 4d=16, so d=4.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Find the sum of the first 15 natural numbers (1 to 15).

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Find the 4th term of the sequence given by Tn = 2n^2 - 1.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: In a geometric progression, a = 3 and r = 2, find the sum of the first 5 terms.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Find the area of a triangle with base 10cm and height 6cm.
questions.explanation: Area of a triangle = (1/2) x base x height = (1/2) x 10 x 6 = 30 cm^2.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Find the circumference of a circle of radius 14cm. (Use pi = 22/7)
questions.explanation: Circumference = 2 pi r = 2 x (22/7) x 14 = 2 x 44 = 88 cm.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Find the volume of a cuboid with length 5cm, width 4cm and height 3cm.
questions.explanation: Volume of a cuboid = length x width x height = 5 x 4 x 3 = 60 cm^3.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Find the area of a trapezium with parallel sides 8cm and 12cm, and height 5cm.
questions.explanation: Area of a trapezium = (1/2)(sum of parallel sides) x height = (1/2)(8+12) x 5 = (1/2)(20)(5) = 50 cm^2.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Find the volume of a cylinder with radius 7cm and height 10cm. (Use pi = 22/7)

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Find the surface area of a cube of side 4cm.
questions.explanation: Surface area of a cube = 6 x side^2 = 6 x 16 = 96 cm^2.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Find the area of a square whose diagonal is 10cm.
questions.explanation: Area of a square in terms of its diagonal d is d^2/2 = 100/2 = 50 cm^2.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Find the perimeter of a square field of area 81 square metres.
questions.explanation: Side = sqrt(81) = 9 m. Perimeter = 4 x side = 4 x 9 = 36 m.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: A rectangular tank has length 6m, width 4m and height 2m. Find its volume.
questions.explanation: Volume = length x width x height = 6 x 4 x 2 = 48 m^3.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Find the area of a circle of diameter 21cm. (Use pi = 22/7)

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Find the volume of a cone with radius 3cm and height 7cm. (Use pi = 22/7)

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Find the total surface area of a cylinder with radius 7cm and height 3cm. (Use pi = 22/7)
questions.explanation: Total surface area = 2 pi r(h+r) = 2 x (22/7) x 7 x (3+7) = 2 x 22 x 10 = 440 cm^2.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: A right triangle has legs 6cm and 8cm. Find the length of the hypotenuse.
questions.explanation: By Pythagoras' theorem, hypotenuse = sqrt(6^2+8^2) = sqrt(36+64) = sqrt(100) = 10 cm.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Find the area of a parallelogram with base 9cm and height 5cm.
questions.explanation: Area of a parallelogram = base x height = 9 x 5 = 45 cm^2.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Find the length of an arc of a circle of radius 21cm subtending an angle of 60 degrees at the centre. (Use pi = 22/7)

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Two angles on a straight line are x and 3x. Find the value of x.
questions.explanation: Angles on a straight line sum to 180 degrees, so x + 3x = 180, giving 4x = 180, so x = 45.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Two angles are complementary. If one angle is 35 degrees, find the other.
questions.explanation: Complementary angles sum to 90 degrees, so the other angle is 90 - 35 = 55 degrees.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Two angles are supplementary. If one angle is 110 degrees, find the other.
questions.explanation: Supplementary angles sum to 180 degrees, so the other angle is 180 - 110 = 70 degrees.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: In a triangle, two of the angles are 50 degrees and 60 degrees. Find the third angle.
questions.explanation: The angles of a triangle sum to 180 degrees, so the third angle is 180 - 50 - 60 = 70 degrees.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Find the sum of the interior angles of a pentagon (5 sides).
questions.explanation: Sum of interior angles = (n-2) x 180. For a pentagon (n=5): (5-2) x 180 = 540°.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Each exterior angle of a regular polygon is 40 degrees. Find the number of sides.
questions.explanation: The number of sides = 360/exterior angle = 360/40 = 9.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Find the size of each interior angle of a regular hexagon.
questions.explanation: Sum of interior angles = (6-2) x 180 = 720°. Each angle = 720/6 = 120°.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: In triangle ABC, AB = AC and angle B = 70 degrees. Find angle A.
questions.explanation: Since AB=AC, the base angles B and C are equal, so angle C = 70°. Angle A = 180 - 70 - 70 = 40°.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: In a triangle, the angles are x, 2x and 3x. Find the value of x.
questions.explanation: The angles sum to 180 degrees: x + 2x + 3x = 180, so 6x = 180, giving x = 30°.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Two parallel lines are cut by a transversal. If one co-interior angle is 65 degrees, find the other.
questions.explanation: Co-interior (allied) angles between parallel lines sum to 180 degrees, so the other angle is 180 - 65 = 115°.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Find the value of sin 30°.
questions.explanation: sin 30° is a standard trigonometric value equal to 0.5.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Find the value of cos 60°.
questions.explanation: cos 60° is a standard trigonometric value equal to 0.5.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Find the value of tan 45°.
questions.explanation: tan 45° is a standard trigonometric value equal to 1, since sin 45° equals cos 45°.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: In a right triangle, the side opposite an angle is 3cm and the hypotenuse is 5cm. Find sin of the angle.
questions.explanation: sin(theta) = opposite/hypotenuse = 3/5 = 0.6.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: In a right triangle, the side adjacent to an angle is 4cm and the hypotenuse is 5cm. Find cos of the angle.
questions.explanation: cos(theta) = adjacent/hypotenuse = 4/5 = 0.8.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: If tan(theta) = 3/4, find sin(theta), using a right triangle with sides 3, 4 and 5.
questions.explanation: With opposite=3, adjacent=4, the hypotenuse is 5 (3-4-5 triangle), so sin(theta) = 3/5 = 0.6.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Find the value of sin^2 30° + cos^2 30°.
questions.explanation: By the trigonometric identity sin^2(theta) + cos^2(theta) = 1 for any angle theta.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Find the angle theta, where 0° < theta < 90°, if sin(theta) = 0.5.
questions.explanation: Since sin 30° = 0.5, theta = 30°.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: A ladder leans against a wall making an angle of 60 degrees with the ground. If the foot of the ladder is 3m from the wall, find the length of the ladder. (cos 60° = 0.5)
questions.explanation: cos(60°) = adjacent/hypotenuse, so hypotenuse = 3/0.5 = 6m, giving the ladder length as 6m.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Find the value of cos 0°.
questions.explanation: cos 0° is a standard trigonometric value equal to 1.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Find the mean of the data set: 3, 5, 7, 9, 11.
questions.explanation: Mean = sum of values/number of values = 35/5 = 7.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Find the range of the data set: 12, 18, 7, 25, 9.
questions.explanation: Range = highest value - lowest value = 25 - 7 = 18.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: A die is rolled once. Find the probability of getting a number greater than 4.
questions.explanation: Numbers greater than 4 on a die are 5 and 6, so probability = 2/6 = 1/3.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Two coins are tossed together. Find the probability of getting exactly one head.
questions.explanation: The possible outcomes are HH, HT, TH, TT. Exactly one head occurs in HT and TH, giving probability 2/4 = 1/2.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Find the mean of the first 6 positive even numbers: 2, 4, 6, 8, 10, 12.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: A bag contains 4 red balls and 6 blue balls. Find the probability that a ball picked at random is red.
questions.explanation: Total balls = 10. Probability of red = 4/10 = 2/5.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Find the mode of the data set: 3, 5, 5, 7, 9, 5, 11.
questions.explanation: The mode is the most frequently occurring value; 5 appears three times, more than any other value.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: From a standard pack of 52 playing cards, one card is drawn at random. Find the probability that it is a king.
questions.explanation: There are 4 kings in a pack of 52 cards, so probability = 4/52 = 1/13.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Find the median of the data set: 5, 11, 2, 8, 14, 3.
questions.explanation: Arranged in order: 2, 3, 5, 8, 11, 14. With 6 values, the median is the average of the 3rd and 4th: (5+8)/2 = 6.5.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: A basket has 3 green, 5 yellow and 2 orange fruits. Find the probability of picking a yellow fruit at random.
questions.explanation: Total fruits = 10. Probability of yellow = 5/10 = 1/2.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: A trader buys goods for N5,000 and sells them for N6,500. Find the percentage profit.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: A man's salary is increased from N40,000 to N46,000. Find the percentage increase.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Divide N15,000 between two people in the ratio 2:3. Find the smaller share.
questions.explanation: Total parts = 2+3 = 5. Each part = 15,000/5 = 3,000. Smaller share = 2 x 3,000 = N6,000.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: A car travels 210km in 3 hours. Find its average speed in km/h.
questions.explanation: Average speed = distance/time = 210/3 = 70 km/h.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: A sum of N24,000 is shared among three boys in the ratio 1:2:3. Find the largest share.
questions.explanation: Total parts = 1+2+3 = 6. Each part = 24,000/6 = 4,000. Largest share = 3 x 4,000 = N12,000.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: The price of an item after a 20% increase is N960. Find the original price.
questions.explanation: If N960 represents 120% of the original price, original price = 960/1.2 = N800.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: A cyclist covers 45km in 1.5 hours. Find the speed.
questions.explanation: Speed = distance/time = 45/1.5 = 30 km/h.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: In an exam, a student scored 56 out of 80. Find the percentage score.
questions.explanation: Percentage = (56/80) x 100 = 70%.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: A shop reduces the price of a shirt from N2,500 to N2,000. Find the percentage discount.
questions.explanation: Discount = 2,500 - 2,000 = 500. Percentage discount = (500/2,500) x 100 = 20%.

questions.subject: Mathematics
questions.text: Three workers, each working at the same rate, can complete a job together in 12 days. How long would it take one worker alone to complete the same job?
questions.explanation: Working together, their combined rate is 3 times a single worker's rate, so one worker alone takes 3 x 12 = 36 days.
